integrity: The universal identity is proved directly from the published equations. Exact rational replay checks the default-parameter witness and several algebraic instances. Originality is supported by targeted database, source-text, and web searches but is not an exhaustive literature proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is a structural identity and threshold comparison for the two-attitude ODE system; it does not claim that the explicit witness is visited by the paper's default trajectory or that the reported epidemic-wave numerics change.
title: Infection selection shifts the behavior-composition threshold in a two-attitude epidemic model
